entries: **The usage report shows where each dispatch quota went.** The dispatch ledger's seven-column table is now "Where your dispatch quota went (last 7 days)": one block per quota, for Codex and each Antigravity model group, with how much of it is used this week, the conversations whose dispatched work used it (top five, then "N more"), and the rest as "Other (your own use, or no dispatch record found)". Antigravity groups each have their own weekly quota and are no longer added together; the old table could total more than 100%. When all of Codex's usage came before its reset, the block says so in one line.

**The Muse card records a used-up weekly allowance as the weekly limit.** Muse sends the same "Subscription quota exhausted" error for both limits, and v0.34.5 always recorded it as the 5-hour window. A used-up week showed "Session 100%, resets in 3 days" while the weekly row kept an old reading. A reset more than 5 hours away now marks the weekly row as 100% with that reset time.
**Wrapped captions say "over the past year".** The data covers a rolling 53 weeks, not the calendar year.

title.zh-TW: 用量報表按派工額度分塊顯示，清楚列出對話消耗明細
title.en: Usage report splits dispatch quotas into separate blocks with per-conversation details

body.zh-TW: 當你頻繁指派 AI 處理各類任務時，常常需要確認不同模型的配額到底耗費在哪些對話上。派工帳本原本採用七欄表格，現在改為「派工額度花在哪（最近 7 天）」，替 Codex 與每個 Antigravity 模型群組各自獨立分塊。⟦跟翻閱專案的請款帳本一樣，以前所有項目的開銷全擠在一張大表格裡，既難以對照個別上限，加總甚至還會莫名破表；現在各預算項目獨立成頁，清楚列出金額最高的前幾筆花費，對帳時便能逐筆核實。⟧每個區塊都會標出本週已用額度，並列出消耗最多的前五個派工對話，其餘對話寫成「另外 N 段」，剩下的用量歸入「其他（你直接用的，或沒對到派工紀錄）」。Antigravity 每個群組各自計算週額度，不再合併相加，避免舊表格加總超過 100% 的情形；若 Codex 用量全在額度重置前發生，該區塊也會以一句話說明。
body.en: When you frequently assign AI different tasks, you often need to check which conversations have used up each model’s quota. The dispatch ledger’s seven-column table has now been replaced with “Where your dispatch quota went (last 7 days),” with separate blocks for Codex and each Antigravity model group. ⟦It works like reviewing a project’s expense ledger: previously, every item’s spending was crammed into one large table, making it hard to check against individual limits, and the totals could even inexplicably exceed the budget. Now each budget category has its own page listing the largest expenses, so you can verify them individually when reconciling the accounts.⟧ Each block shows the quota used this week and lists the top five conversations whose dispatched work used it. Remaining conversations appear as “N more,” and the remaining usage goes under “Other (your own use, or no dispatch record found).” Each Antigravity group’s weekly quota is calculated separately instead of being added together, preventing the old table’s totals from exceeding 100%. If all Codex usage occurred before the quota reset, its block also explains that in a sentence.

items.original: **The usage report shows where each dispatch quota went.** The dispatch ledger's seven-column table is now "Where your dispatch quota went (last 7 days)": one block per quota, for Codex and each Antigravity model group, with how much of it is used this week, the conversations whose dispatched work used it (top five, then "N more"), and the rest as "Other (your own use, or no dispatch record found)". Antigravity groups each have their own weekly quota and are no longer added together; the old table could total more than 100%. When all of Codex's usage came before its reset, the block says so in one line.

title.zh-TW: Muse 週額度用盡正確歸屬，卡片依重置時間標記上限
title.en: Muse weekly quota exhaustion is correctly identified, with cards marking limits by reset time

body.zh-TW: 長時間使用 Muse 容易撞上用量限制，此時介面回報哪種額度見底，決定了它告訴你要等多久。Muse 的五小時額度與週額度用完時，都會回傳相同的「Subscription quota exhausted」（訂閱額度已耗盡）錯誤訊息。⟦像在手機門市查詢多個方案用量，以前不管哪種配額見底，簡訊都只通報短週期方案已滿，明明是週方案用盡卻標註三天後重置；現在若重置間隔拉長，介面便會精準指出真正用滿的是長週期配額，並如實標上恢復時間。⟧舊版 v0.34.5 一律將該錯誤判定為五小時額度耗盡，導致週額度用完時，卡片顯示「工作階段 100%、3 天後重置」，而週額度那列仍停在舊數字。現在只要重置時間超過 5 小時，卡片就會把週額度記錄為 100%，並帶上正確的重置時間。
body.en: Extended use of Muse can hit usage limits, and which quota the interface reports as exhausted determines how long it tells you to wait. Muse returns the same “Subscription quota exhausted” error message whether its five-hour or weekly quota runs out. ⟦Imagine checking usage across several plans at a mobile phone store. Previously, whichever quota ran out, the text message only reported that the short-cycle plan was full. Even when the weekly plan was exhausted, it showed a reset in three days. Now, if the reset interval is longer, the interface accurately identifies the longer-cycle quota as the one that is full and shows its actual recovery time.⟧ The old v0.34.5 always treated this error as five-hour quota exhaustion. When the weekly quota ran out, the card therefore showed “Session 100%, resets in 3 days,” while the weekly quota row still displayed its previous value. Now, whenever the reset is more than 5 hours away, the card records the weekly quota as 100% and includes the correct reset time.

items.original: **The Muse card records a used-up weekly allowance as the weekly limit.** Muse sends the same "Subscription quota exhausted" error for both limits, and v0.34.5 always recorded it as the 5-hour window. A used-up week showed "Session 100%, resets in 3 days" while the weekly row kept an old reading. A reset more than 5 hours away now marks the weekly row as 100% with that reset time.

title.zh-TW: Wrapped 說明文字改為近一年，反映滾動 53 週數據
title.en: Wrapped description now says “over the past year” to reflect rolling 53-week data

body.zh-TW: 翻閱 Wrapped 的個人 AI 用量摘要時，介面標註的時間範圍會直接影響你對數據的理解。Wrapped 實際統計最近連續 53 週，說明文字現在寫成「近一年」，讓你知道這份回顧不是從今年一月一日起算。⟦好比查看運動手環的年累積步數，若沒看清楚統計期間，容易以為紀錄只從一月一日起算；標記成近一年，就能明白數據呈現的是最近一整年的連續走勢。⟧
body.en: When reviewing your personal AI usage summary in Wrapped, the time range shown in the interface directly affects how you interpret the data. Wrapped actually covers the most recent 53 consecutive weeks. Its description now says “over the past year,” making it clear that the review does not start on January 1 of the current year. ⟦Think of checking the yearly step total on a fitness tracker. If you overlook the reporting period, you might assume the record starts on January 1. Labeling it “over the past year” makes it clear that the data shows a continuous trend across the most recent full year.⟧

items.original: **Wrapped captions say "over the past year".** The data covers a rolling 53 weeks, not the calendar year.

entries: **The Muse card shows a used-up 5-hour window even when Muse sends no numbers.** Once the window runs out, Muse usually refuses the quota check with a "Subscription quota exhausted" error that only says when the window resets. The card now shows the window as 100% with that reset time. The error has no weekly figure, so the weekly percentage stays from the last reading and the card keeps its "last checked" badge.

title.zh-TW: Muse 額度用完即使未給數字，卡片也會標示 5 小時已用滿
title.en: Cards mark the 5-hour quota as full even when Muse provides no numbers upon exhaustion

body.zh-TW: 當你連續使用 Muse 處理工作時，一旦額度耗盡，往往會想確認何時才能繼續。以往 5 小時額度一用完，Muse 通常會直接拒絕額度查詢，只拋出「Subscription quota exhausted」錯誤訊息並告知重置時間，導致卡片拿不到具體數字。⟦跟運動場地的租借機一樣，以前名額一被搶光，票機只印出額滿通知與下一場時間，看板卻因抓不到剩餘數值而沒能更新；現在螢幕會直接標示目前時段已全滿，並貼上下次開放進場的時刻。⟧現在卡片遇到這種狀況，會主動把 5 小時額度顯示為 100%，並附上該重置時間。因為這項錯誤回報裡沒有週額度數字，所以卡片上的週額度百分比會沿用上次的讀數，卡片也保留「上次查詢」的時間提示，讓你在等待額度恢復時依然能掌握先前的用量狀態。
body.en: When you use Muse continuously for work, you often want to confirm when you can resume once your quota runs out. Previously, as soon as the 5-hour quota was exhausted, Muse would typically reject quota queries outright, only throwing a "Subscription quota exhausted" error message alongside the reset time, leaving the card without concrete numbers. ⟦Much like a sports venue reservation kiosk, where the ticket machine previously printed only a full notice and the next session time once slots filled up, leaving the display unupdated because it could not fetch the remaining count, the screen now directly marks the current slot as completely full and displays the time for the next admission.⟧ Now when encountering this situation, the card proactively displays the 5-hour quota at 100% and attaches that reset time. Because this error response contains no weekly quota figures, the weekly quota percentage on the card retains its previous reading, and the card also preserves its "last checked" badge, allowing you to keep track of prior usage status while waiting for the quota to recover.

items.original: **The Muse card shows a used-up 5-hour window even when Muse sends no numbers.** Once the window runs out, Muse usually refuses the quota check with a "Subscription quota exhausted" error that only says when the window resets. The card now shows the window as 100% with that reset time. The error has no weekly figure, so the weekly percentage stays from the last reading and the card keeps its "last checked" badge.

entries: **The Muse card stays current after a 5-hour window runs out.** Muse reports an exhausted window as more than 100% used (for example 104%), and `usage` threw those readings away. The card kept the last reading under 100% with a stale-age badge until the window reset; it now shows the window as full.

title.zh-TW: Muse 的 5 小時額度用完後持續更新，用量卡片顯示已用滿
title.en: Muse continues updating after 5-hour quota is exhausted, with usage card showing full

body.zh-TW: 平時頻繁使用 Muse 協作時，如果額度見底，你可能會打開 `usage` 查看剩餘狀況與重置時間。⟦跟看停車場入口的剩餘車位看板一樣，以前場內車輛停滿甚至超額借停時，計數器因為讀到破表數字而停止刷新，螢幕凍結在用滿前一刻並掛著過期提示；現在就算車位全滿，看板也會持續更新並清楚顯示客滿。⟧Muse 在 5 小時額度耗盡時，回報的使用率常會超過 100%（例如 104%）。以前 `usage` 會直接把這種大於 100% 的讀數丟掉。這導致卡片一直停留在低於 100% 的最後一次讀數，並掛著過期標籤（stale-age badge，標示資料多久未更新的標籤），直到 5 小時週期重置。現在卡片在 5 小時額度用完後仍會持續刷新，並清楚標示為已用滿，方便你隨時掌握最新狀態。
body.en: When frequently collaborating with Muse, if your quota runs low, you might open `usage` to check the remaining status and reset time. ⟦Think of the vacancy board at a parking lot entrance. Previously, when the lot was full or even overfilled with parked cars, the counter stopped updating because it read an off-the-charts number, freezing the screen right before full capacity with an expired notice. Now, even when all spaces are full, the board continues to update and clearly displays that the lot is full.⟧ Muse exhausts its 5-hour quota, the reported usage often exceeds 100% (such as 104%). Previously, `usage` would directly discard readings greater than 100%. This caused the card to remain stuck at the last reading below 100% with a stale-age badge (a label indicating how long data has not been updated) until the 5-hour cycle reset. Now, the card continues to refresh after the 5-hour quota is exhausted and clearly indicates that it is full, making it easy for you to track the latest status at any time.

items.original: **The Muse card stays current after a 5-hour window runs out.** Muse reports an exhausted window as more than 100% used (for example 104%), and `usage` threw those readings away. The card kept the last reading under 100% with a stale-age badge until the window reset; it now shows the window as full.

entries: **Windows: the taskbar label stops scanning taskbar buttons while the screen is locked.** The scan runs every 2 seconds through UI Automation and is the main suspect in an unexplained crash that happened while Windows was locked (refs #202). Nothing changes while unlocked. This is a mitigation, not a confirmed fix.

**Auto-start 5-hour Session sends a lighter ping and no longer clutters your resume list.** The Claude ping now loads no tools or MCP servers and is not saved as a session; the Codex ping runs with `--ephemeral`. Each ping used to load about 20k input tokens and leave an "ok" conversation in `claude --resume` and `codex resume`.

title.zh-TW: Windows 鎖定螢幕時，工作列標籤暫停掃描
title.en: On Windows, the taskbar label stops scanning while the screen is locked

body.zh-TW: 有 Windows 使用者回報，電腦鎖定期間 `usage` 曾莫名當掉，原因還沒查清楚（refs #202）。工作列上的額度標籤每 2 秒會透過 UI Automation 掃描一次工作列按鈕，好決定自己擺哪裡，這個掃描是頭號嫌疑。現在螢幕鎖定時就不掃，解鎖後一切照舊。⟦像社區警衛晚上關店後就不再每兩分鐘巡一次空蕩蕩的商店街，以前整夜照巡、偶爾自己絆倒，現在鎖門就休息。⟧官方說得很清楚：這是降低風險的措施，不是確認的修復，如果之後還有當機，請繼續回報。
body.en: Some Windows users reported `usage` crashing for no clear reason while the computer was locked, and the cause is still unknown (refs #202). The quota label on the taskbar scans the taskbar buttons every 2 seconds through UI Automation to decide where to sit, and that scan is the main suspect. It now stops scanning while the screen is locked, and nothing changes while the screen is in use. ⟦A night guard used to patrol the empty shopping street every two minutes all night and occasionally trip; now the patrol pauses once the shutters are down.⟧ The changelog is explicit that this is a mitigation, not a confirmed fix, so keep reporting any further crashes.

items.original: **Windows: the taskbar label stops scanning taskbar buttons while the screen is locked.** The scan runs every 2 seconds through UI Automation and is the main suspect in an unexplained crash that happened while Windows was locked (refs #202). Nothing changes while unlocked. This is a mitigation, not a confirmed fix.

title.zh-TW: 自動啟動 5 小時計時的背景訊息變輕，也不再塞滿接續清單
title.en: Auto-start 5-hour Session sends a lighter ping and stops cluttering your resume list

body.zh-TW: 想接續昨天的對話，打開 `claude --resume` 或 `codex resume` 卻看到一整排只寫著「ok」的紀錄，要翻半天才找到真正的那筆。那些都是「自動啟動 5 小時計時」在背景送出的小訊息留下的，而且每則還會載入約 2 萬 input token（AI 計算用量的單位）。⟦像每天只是去郵局蓋個戳，以前卻得扛整箱文件排隊，還在登記簿留一筆；現在空手去、蓋完就走。⟧現在 Claude 那則不再載入工具和 MCP 伺服器，也不存成工作階段；Codex 那則改用 `--ephemeral` 執行，同樣不留紀錄。
body.en: You want to pick up yesterday's conversation, open `claude --resume` or `codex resume`, and find a long row of entries that just say "ok" before the real one. Those came from the small background pings sent by Auto-start 5-hour Session, and each ping also loaded about 20k input tokens (the unit AI usage is measured in). ⟦It was like going to the post office just for a stamp while hauling a whole box of documents and signing the logbook each time; now you go empty-handed and leave once it is stamped.⟧ The Claude ping now loads no tools or MCP servers and is not saved as a session, and the Codex ping runs with `--ephemeral`, leaving no record either.

items.original: **Auto-start 5-hour Session sends a lighter ping and no longer clutters your resume list.** The Claude ping now loads no tools or MCP servers and is not saved as a session; the Codex ping runs with `--ephemeral`. Each ping used to load about 20k input tokens and leave an "ok" conversation in `claude --resume` and `codex resume`.

entries: **The Windows build ships Pillow 13.0.0.** Pillow 12.3.0, which draws the Windows tray icon and taskbar quota label, had nine known vulnerabilities in its image decoders, one of them critical. `usage` only draws its own icons and never opens images from elsewhere, but installing `usage-cli[windows]` from PyPI now requires Pillow 13.0.0 or later as well.

**The Gemini ⇄ button hides again when Antigravity has only one quota group.** v0.34.1 restyled it in the default panel and the new style overrode its hidden state, so it showed a button that did nothing.
**Heart Monitor's English footer buttons keep their text inside.** "Set Up Status Line" did not fit next to Refresh and Quit; button labels now wrap.

title.zh-TW: Windows 版改用 Pillow 13.0.0，補上圖片解碼漏洞
title.en: The Windows build moves to Pillow 13.0.0 to close image-decoder vulnerabilities

body.zh-TW: 在 Windows 上用 `usage` 的人，工作列那個額度數字和系統匣圖示，背後是靠 Pillow（Python 的繪圖套件）畫出來的。原本用的 Pillow 12.3.0，圖片解碼部分有 9 個已知漏洞，其中 1 個屬嚴重等級。`usage` 只畫自己的圖示，從不打開外來的圖片，所以這些漏洞原本就碰不太到它。⟦就像家裡的門鎖被通報有瑕疵，雖然你從不把鑰匙借人，還是順手換了新鎖。⟧現在 Windows 版改用 Pillow 13.0.0；從 PyPI 安裝 `usage-cli[windows]` 時，也會要求 Pillow 13.0.0 以上，裝的時候會一起升級。
body.en: If you run `usage` on Windows, the quota number on the taskbar and the tray icon are drawn by Pillow (a Python drawing library). The Pillow 12.3.0 it used had nine known vulnerabilities in its image decoders, one of them critical. `usage` only draws its own icons and never opens images from elsewhere, so these flaws were hard to reach anyway. ⟦Think of a lock maker announcing a defect: even if you never lend out your key, you swap in the new lock anyway.⟧ The Windows build now ships Pillow 13.0.0, and installing `usage-cli[windows]` from PyPI requires Pillow 13.0.0 or later, so it upgrades along the way.

items.original: **The Windows build ships Pillow 13.0.0.** Pillow 12.3.0, which draws the Windows tray icon and taskbar quota label, had nine known vulnerabilities in its image decoders, one of them critical. `usage` only draws its own icons and never opens images from elsewhere, but installing `usage-cli[windows]` from PyPI now requires Pillow 13.0.0 or later as well.

title.zh-TW: 沒反應的「Gemini ⇄」按鈕又藏起來了，心電圖面板英文按鈕不再爆字
title.en: The dead "Gemini ⇄" button hides again, and Heart Monitor's English buttons fit their text

body.zh-TW: 畫面上出現一顆按了沒反應的按鈕，很容易讓人以為程式壞了。「Gemini ⇄」按鈕本來只在 Antigravity 有兩組以上額度時才出現，但 v0.34.1 在預設面板替它換了新樣式，新樣式蓋掉了隱藏效果。⟦好比店家換了新招牌，卻忘了把「本日公休」的牌子掛回去，客人推門才發現沒人；現在牌子掛好了，只有一組額度時按鈕會照舊藏起來。⟧心電圖佈景的英文版也有擠字問題：底部「Set Up Status Line」跟 Refresh、Quit 排在同一列放不下，字跑出按鈕外，現在按鈕文字會自動換行。
body.en: A button that does nothing when pressed makes it easy to think the app is broken. The "Gemini ⇄" button is meant to appear only when Antigravity has more than one quota group, but v0.34.1 gave it a new style in the default panel and that style overrode its hidden state. ⟦A shop put up a new sign and forgot to hang the "closed today" notice back up, so customers pushed the door and found nobody; the notice is back, and with only one quota group the button hides as before.⟧ Heart Monitor's English footer was cramped too: "Set Up Status Line" did not fit next to Refresh and Quit and spilled outside its button, and button labels now wrap.

items.original:
**The Gemini ⇄ button hides again when Antigravity has only one quota group.** v0.34.1 restyled it in the default panel and the new style overrode its hidden state, so it showed a button that did nothing.
**Heart Monitor's English footer buttons keep their text inside.** "Set Up Status Line" did not fit next to Refresh and Quit; button labels now wrap.

entries: **The panel's top-right button is now "⚙ Settings".** It opened the whole app menu but was labeled "Switch Panel"; Switch Panel is still in the menu.

**The status line switch moved into the Settings menu.** The "Terminal" button next to Today and Report turned off the status line that feeds the Claude quota, one mis-click away from the range buttons. It is now **Settings → Claude Code → Sync quota via status line** on macOS and Windows, with a tooltip that says what turning it off does. The Projects card keeps Today and Report, in two equal columns in every theme.

**Quota colors stay quiet until a quota is nearly used up.** Percentages and bars no longer turn yellow at 50%; only 80% and above turns red. The default panel shows percentages in the plain text color and keeps each tool's color on its bar, so a low Claude percentage no longer looks like a warning.
**Quota percentages are whole numbers.** Antigravity showed `70.6%` next to whole-number cards. Values round down, so 99.7% never reads as an exhausted 100%.
**The Today / Yesterday total matches the project rows.** Its tokens use the same large green numbers with the cost beside them, in every theme.

**The default panel is cleaner.** A smaller Settings button, Today as the lead button and Report as the quiet one, a centered divider between Session and Weekly, muted labels, thinner bars with a visible 80% mark, aligned project numbers, and status chips that no longer look like buttons.
**Light mode in the default panel is readable again.** Refresh Now and the top project's rank used white text on a light background; white app icons now have an outline on white cards.
**The Windows Muse quota check no longer flashes a console window.**

title.zh-TW: 右上角按鈕改叫「⚙ 設定」，狀態列開關也搬進設定選單
title.en: The top-right button becomes "⚙ Settings" and the status line switch moves into it

body.zh-TW: 想調整 `usage` 的設定時，以前得先猜哪顆按鈕才對。面板右上角那顆按鈕打開的其實是整個 app 的選單，名字卻叫「更換面板」，現在改名「⚙ 設定」，「更換面板」仍留在選單裡。⟦像把總電源開關從玄關鞋櫃旁移進配電箱，以前出門順手一碰就全屋斷電，現在要打開箱門才摸得到。⟧原本「今日」「報告」旁邊的「終端」按鈕，一按就會關掉提供 Claude 額度的狀態列（終端機最底下那一行資訊），離切換範圍的按鈕只差一點。現在要關它得走 **設定 → Claude Code → 狀態列同步額度**，macOS 和 Windows 都一樣，滑鼠停在上面會說明關掉的後果。「專案用量」卡片只留「今日」「報告」，每款佈景都排成兩欄等寬。
body.en: Changing a `usage` setting used to start with guessing which button to press. The top-right button opened the whole app menu but was labeled "Switch Panel"; it is now "⚙ Settings", and Switch Panel is still in that menu. ⟦Moving the main power switch from beside the shoe rack into the fuse box means a stray brush on the way out no longer blacks out the house; now you have to open the box to reach it.⟧ The "Terminal" button next to Today and Report turned off the status line (the info line at the very bottom of the terminal) that feeds the Claude quota, one mis-click away from the range buttons. To turn it off now, go to **Settings → Claude Code → Sync quota via status line**, on both macOS and Windows, with a tooltip explaining what turning it off does. The Projects card keeps Today and Report, in two equal columns in every theme.

items.original:
**The panel's top-right button is now "⚙ Settings".** It opened the whole app menu but was labeled "Switch Panel"; Switch Panel is still in the menu.
**The status line switch moved into the Settings menu.** The "Terminal" button next to Today and Report turned off the status line that feeds the Claude quota, one mis-click away from the range buttons. It is now **Settings → Claude Code → Sync quota via status line** on macOS and Windows, with a tooltip that says what turning it off does. The Projects card keeps Today and Report, in two equal columns in every theme.

title.zh-TW: 額度顏色到 80% 才變紅，百分比一律顯示整數
title.en: Quota colors stay calm until 80%, and percentages are whole numbers

body.zh-TW: 額度才用一半就看到黃色，很容易以為快沒了而停手。現在百分比和進度條不會在 50% 變黃，只有用到 80% 以上才變紅。預設面板的百分比改用一般文字色，各家工具的顏色只留在進度條上，Claude 用量低時看起來不再像警告。數字本身也整齊了：Antigravity 以前會顯示 `70.6%`，旁邊卡片卻都是整數，現在一律顯示整數。⟦加油站的油表只看整格，以前剩一點點也可能被四捨五入成「空」，現在一律往下算，指針不會提早跳到底。⟧小數直接捨去，所以 99.7% 會顯示 99%，不會被看成已用完的 100%。
body.en: Seeing yellow when only half your quota is gone makes it easy to stop work too early. Percentages and bars no longer turn yellow at 50%; they turn red only at 80% and above. The default panel shows percentages in the plain text color and keeps each tool's color on its bar, so a low Claude percentage no longer looks like a warning. The numbers are tidier too: Antigravity used to show `70.6%` next to whole-number cards, and now everything is a whole number. ⟦A fuel gauge that rounds up could flash "empty" with a little left in the tank; this one now always rounds down, so the needle never hits the bottom early.⟧ Values are rounded down, so 99.7% reads as 99% instead of an exhausted 100%.

items.original:
**Quota colors stay quiet until a quota is nearly used up.** Percentages and bars no longer turn yellow at 50%; only 80% and above turns red. The default panel shows percentages in the plain text color and keeps each tool's color on its bar, so a low Claude percentage no longer looks like a warning.
**Quota percentages are whole numbers.** Antigravity showed `70.6%` next to whole-number cards. Values round down, so 99.7% never reads as an exhausted 100%.

title.zh-TW: 預設面板更清爽，淺色模式和 Windows 小毛病一起修好
title.en: A cleaner default panel, plus light-mode and Windows fixes

body.zh-TW: 打開預設面板，第一眼就會覺得比較好讀。底部的「今日／昨日」合計改成跟專案列同一種樣式，token 數用一樣的綠色大數字，金額跟在旁邊，每款佈景都一樣。設定按鈕變小；「今日」是主按鈕，「報告」退成次要按鈕；Session 和每週額度之間有一條置中分隔線，標籤改淡。進度條變細，80% 的刻度看得清楚；專案數字對齊，狀態標籤也不再長得像按鈕。淺色模式下，「立即更新」和第 1 名專案的序號原本是白字配淺色底，現在看得清楚了，白色的 app 圖示在白色卡片上也加了外框。Windows 查 Muse 額度時，不會再突然閃出一個黑色主控台視窗。
body.en: The default panel is easier to read at first glance. The Today / Yesterday total at the bottom now matches the project rows, with tokens in the same large green numbers and the cost beside them, in every theme. The Settings button is smaller; Today is the lead button and Report the quiet one; a centered divider separates Session and weekly, and labels are muted. Bars are thinner with a visible 80% mark, project numbers line up, and status chips no longer look like buttons. In light mode, Refresh Now and the top project's rank used white text on a light background and are readable again, and white app icons now have an outline on white cards. On Windows, checking the Muse quota no longer flashes a black console window.

items.original:
**The Today / Yesterday total matches the project rows.** Its tokens use the same large green numbers with the cost beside them, in every theme.
**The default panel is cleaner.** A smaller Settings button, Today as the lead button and Report as the quiet one, a centered divider between Session and Weekly, muted labels, thinner bars with a visible 80% mark, aligned project numbers, and status chips that no longer look like buttons.
**Light mode in the default panel is readable again.** Refresh Now and the top project's rank used white text on a light background; white app icons now have an outline on white cards.
**The Windows Muse quota check no longer flashes a console window.**

entries: **Muse Code has a quota card.** It shows Muse's 5-hour Session and weekly quota with reset countdowns in all 15 quota themes, with a menu bar item, a hide toggle, and the same near-limit, used-up and restored notifications as Antigravity. Muse keeps no quota file, so `usage` asks Muse itself with one small background request, without a session log and from an empty folder. It checks once when there is no reading yet, then only when the reading is over 30 minutes old and you have used Muse since. Each check uses a little of your Muse quota. A failed check waits for new Muse activity before trying again. Hiding the Muse card stops the checks, and the card hides itself when Muse isn't installed.

**Muse quota shows up wherever the other quotas do.** The Claude Code side pane, `usage status --json`, the multi-agent CLI dashboard, Quota-Aware Mode, and the Windows tray (card, tooltip, hide toggle, and notifications) now include Muse. They only read the last saved reading and never start a Muse check.

**Four or more quota cards switch to a compact layout.** Four full cards no longer fit on a laptop screen, so every quota card shrinks: a smaller header, Session and weekly side by side, and shorter percent and reset text. The Projects title shrinks to match. Three or fewer cards look the same as before.

**The menu bar shows at most three tools.** With Claude Code, Codex, Antigravity, Grok and Muse all on, the strip got too wide and could slide behind the notch. It now keeps the three with the highest Session usage, in the usual order. The panel still shows every card.

**Stale-data warnings are readable in the Windows 95 and Cloud Observation themes.** The red warning sat directly on the Windows 95 blue title bar, and the pale amber one on Cloud Observation's sky-blue cards. Both now have enough contrast. In World Cup 2026, the English MATCH STATS heading is no longer cut off by the buttons next to it.

**Windows saves the quota card order again.** The tray accepted a new order only when it listed exactly the Claude, Codex, and Antigravity cards, so once the Grok card was in the panel, dragging cards into a new order was not saved. It now uses the same check as macOS.

**Auto-start 5-hour Session no longer runs your own hooks.** Its background `claude -p` and `codex exec` pings fired every hook you had set up, such as SessionStart, UserPromptSubmit and Stop hooks, Codex's `hooks.json`, and the `notify` program in Codex's `config.toml`. A hook that sends a notification or saves the conversation ran once for every ping. Claude Code pings now load a settings file with `disableAllHooks`; Codex pings turn off `features.hooks` and `notify`. Antigravity pings are unchanged.

title.zh-TW: Muse Code 有自己的額度卡了
title.en: Muse Code gets its own quota card

body.zh-TW: 你用 Muse 改完一份報告，想知道還能不能再跑一輪？現在點開 `usage` 面板就看得到 Muse 的額度卡：5 小時 Session（從開始用起算的 5 小時用量窗）和每週額度都有，附重置倒數，15 款額度佈景都能用。選單列多了 Muse 項目和隱藏開關，也有跟 Antigravity 一樣的快用完、已用完、已恢復通知。Muse 本機不留額度檔，所以 `usage` 會在背景送一次很小的請求直接問 Muse，不留對話紀錄，而且從空資料夾執行。⟦跟打電話問銀行餘額一樣，每通都要花錢，所以它不會一直打：還沒有讀數時問一次，之後要等讀數超過 30 分鐘、你又用過 Muse 才再問。⟧每問一次會用掉一點 Muse 額度；查詢失敗就等你再用 Muse 才重試。把 Muse 卡片藏起來就完全不查，沒裝 Muse 時卡片會自己隱藏。
body.en: Anyone juggling several AI coding tools dreads finding out mid-task that one of them has run dry. Say you just used Muse to revise a report and wonder whether there is room for another pass: open the `usage` panel and the Muse quota card is there, with the 5-hour Session (the usage window counted from when you start) and the weekly quota, reset countdowns, and support in all 15 quota themes. The menu bar gains a Muse item and a hide toggle, plus the same near-limit, used-up and restored notifications as Antigravity. Muse keeps no quota file on your machine, so `usage` asks Muse directly with one small background request, saving no conversation log and running from an empty folder. ⟦Phoning the bank for your balance costs a little each time, so you would not call every minute: it asks once when there is no reading yet, then only after the reading is over 30 minutes old and you have used Muse since.⟧ Each check uses a little of your Muse quota, and a failed check waits for new Muse activity before retrying. Hiding the Muse card stops the checks, and the card hides itself when Muse is not installed.

items.original: **Muse Code has a quota card.** It shows Muse's 5-hour Session and weekly quota with reset countdowns in all 15 quota themes, with a menu bar item, a hide toggle, and the same near-limit, used-up and restored notifications as Antigravity. Muse keeps no quota file, so `usage` asks Muse itself with one small background request, without a session log and from an empty folder. It checks once when there is no reading yet, then only when the reading is over 30 minutes old and you have used Muse since. Each check uses a little of your Muse quota. A failed check waits for new Muse activity before trying again. Hiding the Muse card stops the checks, and the card hides itself when Muse isn't installed.

title.zh-TW: 側邊面板、終端機儀表板和 Windows 系統匣也看得到 Muse 額度
title.en: Muse quota appears in the side pane, terminal dashboard and Windows tray

body.zh-TW: 你在 Claude Code 裡寫到一半，想順便瞄一眼 Muse 還剩多少，不必再切回 `usage` 的主面板。Claude Code 側邊面板、`usage status --json` 指令、多工具終端機儀表板和額度感知模式，現在都列出 Muse。Windows 系統匣也一樣，卡片、滑鼠停留時的提示文字、隱藏開關和通知都加上了 Muse。⟦以前 Muse 的數字只擺在總店，現在各分店的櫥窗也擺上了，不過分店只陳列總店最後送來的那批貨，自己不會去進貨。⟧這些地方只讀最後一次存下的讀數，從來不會自己發起 Muse 查詢，所以多開幾個地方看，也不會多花你的 Muse 額度。
body.en: You are halfway through work in Claude Code and want a quick look at how much Muse quota is left, without switching back to the main `usage` panel. The Claude Code side pane, the `usage status --json` command, the multi-agent terminal dashboard and Quota-Aware Mode now all list Muse. The Windows tray does too, with Muse in its card, hover tooltip, hide toggle and notifications. ⟦Muse's numbers used to sit only in the flagship store; now every branch window displays them, but the branches only show the last batch the flagship sent over and never restock on their own.⟧ These places read only the last saved reading and never start a Muse check themselves, so looking in more places does not spend any extra Muse quota.

items.original: **Muse quota shows up wherever the other quotas do.** The Claude Code side pane, `usage status --json`, the multi-agent CLI dashboard, Quota-Aware Mode, and the Windows tray (card, tooltip, hide toggle, and notifications) now include Muse. They only read the last saved reading and never start a Muse check.

title.zh-TW: 額度卡變多時自動縮小，選單列最多只放 3 家
title.en: Quota cards shrink when there are many, and the menu bar shows at most three tools

body.zh-TW: 同時用好幾家 AI 工具的人，額度卡一多，筆電螢幕就塞不下。現在只要額度卡有 4 張以上，全部會一起改成精簡版：標題變小、Session 和每週額度並排，百分比和重置文字變短，「專案用量」標題也跟著縮小。3 張以下的樣子跟以前一樣。螢幕最上方的選單列也有同樣的擠法：Claude Code、Codex、Antigravity、Grok、Muse 五家全開時太寬，可能滑到瀏海後面看不到。⟦捷運月台的看板只輪播最近三班車，以前五家擠成一長串、尾巴被瀏海吃掉，現在選單列也只留 Session 用量最高的 3 家，排列順序照舊。⟧想看全部的話，打開面板仍會列出每一張卡。
body.en: If you use several AI tools at once, too many quota cards no longer fit on a laptop screen. Now, once there are four or more quota cards, they all switch to a compact layout together: a smaller header, Session and weekly side by side, and shorter percent and reset text, with the Projects title shrinking to match. Three cards or fewer look the same as before. The menu bar at the top of the screen had the same crowding: with Claude Code, Codex, Antigravity, Grok and Muse all on, it got so wide it could slide behind the notch. ⟦A subway platform sign only cycles through the next three trains; the menu bar used to cram in all five tools until the tail vanished behind the notch, and now it keeps the three with the highest Session usage, in the usual order.⟧ Open the panel and every card is still listed.

items.original:
**Four or more quota cards switch to a compact layout.** Four full cards no longer fit on a laptop screen, so every quota card shrinks: a smaller header, Session and weekly side by side, and shorter percent and reset text. The Projects title shrinks to match. Three or fewer cards look the same as before.
**The menu bar shows at most three tools.** With Claude Code, Codex, Antigravity, Grok and Muse all on, the strip got too wide and could slide behind the notch. It now keeps the three with the highest Session usage, in the usual order. The panel still shows every card.

title.zh-TW: 兩款佈景的過期提示看清楚了，Windows 也記得住卡片排序
title.en: Stale-data warnings are readable in two themes, and Windows remembers card order

body.zh-TW: 換了花俏的佈景，有時反而看不到最該注意的提示。「視窗 95」佈景的紅色過期提示（提醒你數字太久沒更新）原本直接壓在藍色標題列上，「雲圖觀測」的淺橘提示壓在淺藍卡片上，現在兩者都有足夠對比；「世界盃 2026」英文版的 MATCH STATS 標題也不再被旁邊的按鈕擠掉。Windows 這邊，系統匣原本只接受剛好是 Claude 額度卡、Codex、Antigravity 三張卡的排序。⟦像衣帽間只認三號碼牌，多掛一件 Grok 外套就整排登記作廢；以前面板一有 Grok 卡，你拖好的順序就存不起來，現在改用跟 macOS 一樣的檢查，順序會記住。⟧
body.en: A flashy theme can end up hiding the one warning you most need to see. In the Windows 95 theme, the red stale-data warning (a reminder that the numbers have not updated in a while) sat right on the blue title bar, and in Cloud Observation the pale amber one sat on sky-blue cards; both now have enough contrast. In World Cup 2026, the English MATCH STATS heading is no longer cut off by the buttons beside it. On Windows, the tray accepted a new card order only when it listed exactly the Claude, Codex and Antigravity cards. ⟦Picture a cloakroom that only recognizes three ticket numbers, so hanging one extra Grok coat voids the whole row: once a Grok card was in the panel, your dragged order was not saved, and now Windows uses the same check as macOS so the order sticks.⟧

items.original:
**Stale-data warnings are readable in the Windows 95 and Cloud Observation themes.** The red warning sat directly on the Windows 95 blue title bar, and the pale amber one on Cloud Observation's sky-blue cards. Both now have enough contrast. In World Cup 2026, the English MATCH STATS heading is no longer cut off by the buttons next to it.
**Windows saves the quota card order again.** The tray accepted a new order only when it listed exactly the Claude, Codex, and Antigravity cards, so once the Grok card was in the panel, dragging cards into a new order was not saved. It now uses the same check as macOS.

title.zh-TW: 自動啟動 5 小時計時不再觸發你自己設的 hook
title.en: Auto-start 5-hour Session no longer fires your own hooks

body.zh-TW: 設過 hook（特定時機自動觸發的小程式）的人，以前可能莫名收到一堆通知，或多出好幾筆存下的對話。原因是「自動啟動 5 小時計時」在背景執行 `claude -p` 和 `codex exec` 送出小請求，每次都會觸發你設的每個 hook，例如工作階段開始時跑的 SessionStart、UserPromptSubmit、Stop hook，Codex 的 `hooks.json`，還有 Codex `config.toml` 裡的 `notify` 程式。⟦請鐘點清潔工來打掃，他每開一次門，門鈴、監視器通知和自動錄影就全響一輪；現在他改走不會觸動感應器的側門。⟧Claude Code 的背景請求改讀一份開了 `disableAllHooks` 的設定檔，Codex 的背景請求則關掉 `features.hooks` 與 `notify`。Antigravity 不變。
body.en: If you have set up hooks (small programs that run automatically at certain moments), you may have been getting a pile of unexplained notifications or extra saved conversations. The cause: Auto-start 5-hour Session sends small background pings through `claude -p` and `codex exec`, and every ping fired every hook you had set up, such as SessionStart, UserPromptSubmit and Stop hooks, Codex's `hooks.json`, and the `notify` program in Codex's `config.toml`. ⟦Imagine hiring a cleaner who sets off your doorbell, camera alerts and auto-recording every time they open the front door; now they use a side door that trips no sensors.⟧ Claude Code pings now load a settings file with `disableAllHooks` turned on, and Codex pings turn off `features.hooks` and `notify`. Antigravity pings are unchanged.

items.original: **Auto-start 5-hour Session no longer runs your own hooks.** Its background `claude -p` and `codex exec` pings fired every hook you had set up, such as SessionStart, UserPromptSubmit and Stop hooks, Codex's `hooks.json`, and the `notify` program in Codex's `config.toml`. A hook that sends a notification or saves the conversation ran once for every ping. Claude Code pings now load a settings file with `disableAllHooks`; Codex pings turn off `features.hooks` and `notify`. Antigravity pings are unchanged.

entries: **Windows installs hooks and keeps them up to date again.** Since v0.33.2 the Windows build left the hook scripts out of the folder the installer reads, so first-run setup and the resume, terse and quota-aware toggles silently did nothing, and existing hooks stopped updating. macOS was not affected.

title.zh-TW: Windows 版恢復 hook 安裝與更新
title.en: Windows Restores Hook Installation and Updates

body.zh-TW: 若你在 Windows 電腦上使用時，曾碰過切換設定後毫無動靜，現在各項開關都能正常生效了。⟦就像按下電燈開關，以前怎麼按都沒有反應，現在一按燈就亮了。⟧這項問題源自工具仰賴 hook（掛鉤，特定事件發生時被觸發的小程式）來串接各項功能。從 v0.33.2 版起，Windows 打包時未將 hook 腳本放入安裝程式讀取的資料夾，導致安裝程式找不到檔案。連帶讓首次設定，以及接續對話、精簡模式與額度感知等開關在點擊後靜默沒有反應，原本已裝好的 hook 也停止更新。macOS 系統完全不受此問題影響。現在 Windows 版已恢復正常，能順利安裝並持續更新 hook。
body.en: If you previously experienced toggling settings on Windows with no response, all switches now take effect normally. ⟦Think of flipping a light switch: pressing it previously produced no reaction at all, but now the light turns on immediately.⟧ This issue stemmed from the tool relying on hooks (scripts triggered when specific events occur) to connect various features. Starting from v0.33.2, Windows packaging failed to include hook scripts in the folder read by the installer, leaving the installer unable to find the files. Consequently, initial setup as well as switches for continuing conversations, compact mode, and quota awareness silently failed to respond when clicked, and previously installed hooks also stopped updating. macOS is completely unaffected by this issue. Windows has now returned to normal, smoothly installing and continuously updating hooks.

items.original: **Windows installs hooks and keeps them up to date again.** Since v0.33.2 the Windows build left the hook scripts out of the folder the installer reads, so first-run setup and the resume, terse and quota-aware toggles silently did nothing, and existing hooks stopped updating. macOS was not affected.

entries: **The Antigravity card can switch to the Gemini 4 Argon quota.** The group toggle now cycles Gemini → Claude / GPT → Argon. Argon has a weekly limit only, so its 5-hour row says so. The Claude Code side pane and the Antigravity status line leave Argon out.

**Report rows show their share as a faint tint across the row.** The thin bars along each row's bottom edge read as crooked underlines; rows now fill with the tool's color up to their share, with spacing instead of separator lines.

**Antigravity shows its Gemini weekly quota again.** Google's quota API stopped reporting it, so usage now asks the Antigravity CLI itself (`agy -p /usage`, which makes no model call) and falls back to the API when the CLI is unavailable.

**The quota reminder no longer makes Claude think Antigravity is used up.** Each line names the tool and models it limits, a spent Antigravity group is followed by the groups that still have quota, and the reminder ends with Claude Code's own usage.
**Grok usage has an API-equivalent value again.** Grok models now match their xAI price entries instead of counting as $0.

**The usage report no longer contradicts itself.** The weekly summary names the completed weeks it compares, a partial first week no longer produces changes like +980%, the converted amount is called "API equivalent" everywhere, Wrapped notes which days have saved prices, the "All" range explains that earlier days only have daily totals, the dispatch ledger labels its columns as weekly quota shares, and rankings say they are by tokens.

title.zh-TW: Antigravity 卡片支援切換至 Argon 額度
title.en: Antigravity Card Supports Switching to Argon Quota

body.zh-TW: 用 Antigravity 的 Gemini 4 Argon 時，現在也能在卡片上看到它的額度。卡片上的群組切換按鈕現在會依序輪播，在 Gemini、Claude 與 GPT 之外，多了一組 Gemini 4 Argon 可以選。⟦正如冷氣遙控器上的模式切換鍵，以前只能在冷氣和除濕之間跳轉，現在多按一下就能切到全新的節能風速，隨時掌握每週能吹多久。⟧由於 Argon 只有每週總額度，原本顯示五小時用量的那一列會直接清楚說明，不會讓你猜測數字為何空白。至於 Claude Code 側邊面板與 Antigravity 的 status line（顯示在終端機最底下的狀態列）則維持精簡，不會顯示 Argon 的資訊。
body.en: If you use Gemini 4 Argon in Antigravity, the card can now show its quota too. The group toggle button on the card now cycles sequentially, adding a Gemini 4 Argon option alongside Gemini, Claude, and GPT. ⟦Think of the mode button on an air conditioner remote: where you previously could only toggle between cooling and dehumidifying, one extra press now switches to a brand-new eco fan speed to track how long you can run it each week.⟧ Because Argon only provides a weekly total quota, the row that previously displayed five-hour usage now explains this clearly rather than leaving you guessing why the number is blank. Meanwhile, the Claude Code side panel and the Antigravity status line (the status bar displayed at the bottom of the terminal) remain streamlined, omitting Argon information.

items.original: **The Antigravity card can switch to the Gemini 4 Argon quota.** The group toggle now cycles Gemini → Claude / GPT → Argon. Argon has a weekly limit only, so its 5-hour row says so. The Claude Code side pane and the Antigravity status line leave Argon out.

title.zh-TW: 用量報表改用淡色底填滿佔比，版面更易閱讀
title.en: Usage Reports Use Soft Background Fills for Proportions to Improve Readability

body.zh-TW: 每次打開用量報表想比較各工具的花費時，現在一眼就看得出誰佔得多。原本貼在每列最底部的細條，視覺上往往容易讓人誤以為是排版畫歪的文字底線；現在每一列會依照實際的使用佔比，順著整列填滿該工具專屬的柔和淡色底色。⟦跟用螢光筆畫重點一樣，以前像拿細原子筆在字底下劃出歪斜線段，現在直接順著長度刷上一層淡色標記，一眼就能看清誰佔了最多篇幅。⟧不同工具的列與列之間，也改用乾淨舒適的間距留白，直接取代原本生硬的分隔線，讓整張統計報表變得清爽易讀。
body.en: Whenever you open usage reports to compare spending across tools, you can now see at a glance which one takes the largest share. The thin bar originally tucked at the bottom of each row was often visually mistaken for a misaligned text underline; now, each row fills across with its tool-specific soft pastel background based on actual usage share. ⟦Picture using a marker to highlight key points: instead of scratching crooked lines under text with a fine ballpoint pen, a gentle wash of color now brushes along the entire row so you can spot who takes up the most space at a glance.⟧ Clean, comfortable spacing between rows of different tools directly replaces the rigid dividers, leaving the entire statistics report crisp and readable.

items.original: **Report rows show their share as a faint tint across the row.** The thin bars along each row's bottom edge read as crooked underlines; rows now fill with the tool's color up to their share, with spacing instead of separator lines.

title.zh-TW: Antigravity 額度顯示修復，不再漏看週額度或誤判耗盡
title.en: Antigravity Quota Display Fixed to Prevent Missing Weekly Quotas or False Exhaustion

body.zh-TW:
使用 Antigravity 時，你可能遇過額度資訊消失、甚至讓助理誤判停工的窘境。⟦彷彿盤點庫存，以前清單漏列一筆就以為全部缺貨，現在會翻開帳冊查證，並把各貨架剩餘品項交代清楚。⟧

Gemini 週額度重新回歸。由於 Google 的額度 API（提供用量數據的介面）不再回報該數字，usage 改直接向 Antigravity CLI 執行 `agy -p /usage` 查詢且不呼叫模型，無法執行時才退回原 API。

發給 Claude 的額度提醒也不再引發誤會。過去某組額度耗盡，容易讓 Claude 誤以為 Antigravity 徹底停用；現在提示每行都會寫明受限的工具與模型組別，並緊接著列出仍有剩餘額度的組別，末端還會附上 Claude Code 自身用量。
body.en:
When using Antigravity, you may have encountered quota information vanishing or even causing an assistant to mistakenly halt work. ⟦Much like taking inventory where a single line missing from a list made you assume everything was out of stock, staff now open the ledger to verify records and clearly account for items left on each shelf.⟧

Gemini weekly quotas make a return. Because Google's quota API (the interface providing usage metrics) no longer reports this figure, usage now queries the Antigravity CLI directly with `agy -p /usage` without invoking models, only falling back to the original API if execution fails.

Quota reminders sent to Claude no longer cause misunderstandings. In the past, exhausting a single quota easily led Claude to assume Antigravity was entirely out of commission; now, every reminder line specifies the constrained tool and model group, immediately followed by groups that still have remaining quota, with Claude Code's own usage appended at the end.

items.original:
**Antigravity shows its Gemini weekly quota again.** Google's quota API stopped reporting it, so usage now asks the Antigravity CLI itself (`agy -p /usage`, which makes no model call) and falls back to the API when the CLI is unavailable.
**The quota reminder no longer makes Claude think Antigravity is used up.** Each line names the tool and models it limits, a spent Antigravity group is followed by the groups that still have quota, and the reminder ends with Claude Code's own usage.

title.zh-TW: 用量報表前後矛盾修復，計費與標籤口徑一致
title.en: Usage Report Inconsistencies Fixed to Align Cost and Label Definitions

body.zh-TW:
翻閱長期的統計數據時，你可能曾被突然飆高的百分比或不明金額嚇了一跳。⟦如同重新校對後的家庭記帳本，以前看到莫名暴增的支出總讓人困惑，現在每一筆開銷都標明計算方式與比較週期，帳目清清楚楚。⟧

換算金額在全頁統一稱為「API 等值」，不再有混淆稱呼。過去 Grok 模型一律算成零元，現在會正確對上 xAI 官方價格並算回等值金額，Wrapped 統計也會特別註明哪些日期具備價格紀錄。

報表計算邏輯也補齊了各項說明。週總結現在會清楚寫明比較的是哪兩個完整週，不足七天起步的首週不再算出暴增 980% 這類離奇數字；切到「全部」時間範圍時，會備註更早之前僅有每日總量。各模組標示也一併釐清，派工帳本欄位寫明為週額度佔比，各項排行也明訂依 token（AI 處理與計費的文字單位）排序。
body.en:
Browsing long-term statistics, you might have been startled by suddenly spiking percentages or unexplained amounts. ⟦Like a reconciled household ledger where an unexplained surge in expenses once caused confusion, every outgoing cost now notes its calculation method and comparison timeframe, keeping the accounts completely transparent.⟧

Converted amounts are consistently labeled throughout the page as “API equivalent” to eliminate confusing naming. Past Grok models were always calculated as zero dollars, but they now properly match official xAI pricing to calculate equivalent amounts, and Wrapped statistics specifically note which dates have pricing records.

Report calculation logic now includes comprehensive explanations. Weekly summaries state clearly which two complete weeks are being compared, preventing partial initial weeks of fewer than seven days from producing bizarre figures like a 980% surge. Switching to the “All” timeframe adds a note that earlier periods only record daily totals. Module labels have also been clarified, specifying the task ledger column as a percentage of weekly quota and explicitly sorting rankings by tokens (text units used for AI processing and billing).

items.original:
**Grok usage has an API-equivalent value again.** Grok models now match their xAI price entries instead of counting as $0.
**The usage report no longer contradicts itself.** The weekly summary names the completed weeks it compares, a partial first week no longer produces changes like +980%, the converted amount is called "API equivalent" everywhere, Wrapped notes which days have saved prices, the "All" range explains that earlier days only have daily totals, the dispatch ledger labels its columns as weekly quota shares, and rankings say they are by tokens.

entries: **Antigravity shows your Gemini quota again.** Google's quota summary no longer returns the Gemini group. usage now reads Gemini's five-hour quota from the model list. Google does not currently report its weekly quota; the card labels it as not reported. While the app is running, the Antigravity CLI status line uses these numbers too.
**The Antigravity 5-hour row says "Paused" once the weekly quota is used up.** Google pauses the 5-hour limit at that point, and the row used to read "0% used / Quota full", which looked usable.

title.zh-TW: Antigravity 恢復顯示 Gemini 額度，週額度用盡改標暫停
title.en: Antigravity Restores Gemini Quota Display and Labels It Paused When Weekly Quota Runs Out

body.zh-TW: 當你打開終端機準備趕工，卻擔心用量超標時，現在不必再對著空白面板瞎猜了。⟦好比運動中心的計時卡，以前週額度用完時，當天的五小時欄位還顯示全滿；現在不僅能從清單找回剩餘額度，總量用盡時也會改標為暫停。⟧先前 Google 的額度摘要不再回傳 Gemini 群組，讓 Antigravity 一度看不到用量。現在 usage 改從模型清單直接讀取 Gemini 的 5 小時額度。由於 Google 目前未回報週額度，卡片上會清楚標明未回報。只要應用程式開著，Antigravity CLI 的 status line（顯示在終端機最底下的狀態列）也會同步顯示這組數字。一旦週額度用盡，Google 會在此時暫停 5 小時限額。過去該列會顯示「0% 已用／額度全滿」，容易讓人誤以為還能用；現在 5 小時那一列會直接改標為「暫停」，避免誤判。
body.en: When you open your terminal to work under a deadline and worry about exceeding usage, you no longer have to guess against a blank panel. ⟦Think of a sports center pass: in the past, when the weekly quota ran out, the day's five-hour slot still showed completely full; now it not only retrieves the remaining quota from the list, but also marks it as paused once the total is exhausted.⟧ Previously, Google's quota summary stopped returning the Gemini group, leaving Antigravity temporarily unable to see usage. Now usage reads Gemini's 5-hour quota directly from the model list instead. Because Google does not currently report weekly quota, the card clearly marks it as unreported. As long as the application is running, the Antigravity CLI status line (the status bar displayed at the very bottom of the terminal) also displays these numbers in sync. Once the weekly quota is exhausted, Google pauses the 5-hour limit at that point. In the past, that row displayed "0% used / Quota full", easily misleading users into thinking it was still usable; now the 5-hour row is directly labeled "Paused" to avoid misjudgment.

items.original:
**Antigravity shows your Gemini quota again.** Google's quota summary no longer returns the Gemini group. usage now reads Gemini's five-hour quota from the model list. Google does not currently report its weekly quota; the card labels it as not reported. While the app is running, the Antigravity CLI status line uses these numbers too.
**The Antigravity 5-hour row says "Paused" once the weekly quota is used up.** Google pauses the 5-hour limit at that point, and the row used to read "0% used / Quota full", which looked usable.
